final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT product_id, COUNT(*) as count_per_product FROM Order_Items GROUP BY product_id), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count_per_product) as total_items FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT step1.product_id, step1.count_per_product, CAST(step1.count_per_product AS REAL) / step2.total_items as proportion FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT step3.product_id, step3.count_per_product, step3.proportion, step3.proportion - step4.avg_proportion as difference FROM step3, step4 WHERE step3.proportion > step4.avg_proportion) SELECT SUM(count_per_product) as sum_counts, AVG(proportion) as avg_proportion, AVG(difference) as avg_difference FROM step5
